Hint.select: Click selects, double-click opens the sheet. Drag objects and line points. Delete removes.
Hint.object: Click places an object and opens its sheet.
Hint.line: Click adds a point, double-click finishes, right-click removes the last point.
Hint.area: Drag over cells to paint them. Hold Alt to draw a freehand outline.
Hint.erase: Select an area and drag over cells to erase. Hold Alt to cut a freehand outline.

Atlas.name: Atlas: {scene}
Atlas.typesHint: A type's look applies to all its features unless a feature overrides it.
Atlas.layersHint: Areas live on layers. A hidden layer is not drawn for anyone. The top layer in the list is drawn first.
Atlas.removeTypeConfirm: Delete type “{name}”? Its features stay and fall back to the default look.
Atlas.removeLayerConfirm: Delete layer “{name}”? Its areas stay but belong to no layer.
Atlas.lastLayer: At least one layer is required.

Feature.name: Name
Feature.role: Kind of link: capital, source, alliance…
Feature.styleHint: An empty field uses the type's value.

Claims.title: Claims
Claims.draftEmpty: The draft is empty. Everything you change on the map lands here; the GM sees it only after you submit.
Claims.claimTitle: Claim title, e.g. “The hill folk come to the valley”
Claims.claimNote: What you want and why it is possible
Claims.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw the claim? Its changes will be lost.
Claims.hasConflicts: Some changes disagree with the map.
Claims.conflictsText: These changes were made against an older map:
Claims.trustedHint: Claims from trusted players are accepted at once:

Check.speaker: World map
Check.title: Claim check
Check.difficultyHint: As in Vitruvium: 1 is easy, 6 is nearly impossible. Weigh what the world already holds.
Check.noActor: A character is needed: select a token or assign a character to the user.
Check.cardMissing: The check card is not in the chat.

Notify.noAtlas: This scene has no atlas yet. The GM creates it by opening the map.
Notify.featureMissing: The feature is no longer on the map.
Notify.selectAreaToErase: Select the area to erase first.

autoApplyOnSuccess.name: Accept a claim on success
autoApplyOnSuccess.hint: If a claim check succeeds, its changes go on the map at once. The GM decides partial successes and failures.

renderBelowTokens.name: Draw the map below tokens
renderBelowTokens.hint: Experimental. The map sits between the background and tokens instead of above the scene.
